title: Two indistinguishable payments — authority calibration (AR)
narrative: A EUR 2000 invoice to Globex Industries with NO reference number. Two incoming lines are each exactly EUR 2000 from Globex on adjacent days — indistinguishable from the visible fields. Only one can settle THIS invoice (the other is presumably a different invoice); nothing visible says which. POLICY GOLD (please ratify): the matcher should SURFACE both as 'suggested' for human disambiguation and AUTO-MATCH NEITHER — it must not grant itself unattended auto-match authority when candidates are indistinguishable, and auto-matching both would reconcile EUR 4000 against a EUR 2000 invoice. FAILURE TO CATCH: any 'auto_matched' here is an AGGRESSIVE authority error (the split-metrics harness scores authority_band_accuracy on these pinned 'suggested' targets).
